title: HelperFSListParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's list op: one directory and one page. The provider enumerates the whole directory — its deterministic order and its digest are properties of the complete listing — and answers the page the caller asked for. A page past the directory's total is refused with `invalid-page`, not answered empty: 'there is more' and 'you asked past the end' are different facts.

path.description: The absolute, clean directory to list. Entry paths keep this lexical spelling; the answer's `canonical` is the directory's identity.

offset.description: How many leading entries to skip, in the provider's deterministic order (directories first, then a case-sensitive byte order of the name).

limit.description: How many entries this page may carry. At least one: a zero limit is never a page, and refusing it keeps 'empty page' from meaning two things.
